purpose: Re-run the exact R2R2 fresh 320-case holdout after separately qualifying the reference upper-bracket repair and the physical-envelope-certified candidate remediation. No fresh-case, threshold or scoring changes are allowed.

identity_with_failed_R2R2.rule: No new seed, resampling, case deletion, case substitution or adaptive case selection is permitted. The formerly failing B01 fresh_near_0023 and O14 fresh_near_0003 remain in place.

reference_policy.h_surface_eq_0: Unchanged R2P endpoint-aware reference: q=KSAT plus derived h=0 plateau only when endpoint path length is below 5 cm, otherwise regular interior root.

reference_policy.crosscheck: 100-digit adaptive t^8 oracle on the same preselected two probes per material.

candidate_policy.h_surface_eq_0: Unchanged existing endpoint candidate under R2P-qualified semantics.
candidate_policy.h_surface_gt_0_gt_h_top: R2 analytic saturated segment plus existing bounded negative-head quadrature; if and only if its exact-upper bracket has both finite residuals positive and the R3 analytic K<=KSAT physical root envelope certifies both frozen error gates, return q_upper.

qualification_logic.per_material: All 80 original fresh probes valid; reference and candidate counts zero; all frozen accuracy/cost/endpoint checks pass; all preselected crosschecks pass.
qualification_logic.overall: All four materials independently pass. No pooled averaging or omission of a failed material is allowed.
qualification_logic.failure: Persist failure as frozen. Do not alter seeds, thresholds, candidate, reference or sample membership inside this gate.
